description: This file defines the DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator class, which contains methods to evaluate and test database permissions related to schema creation, CRUD operations, alterations, foreign keys, and dropping tables within the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes Doctrine DBAL for database interactions and schema modifications, primarily for testing or permission validation purposes.

classes.name: DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator
classes.description: A utility class to evaluate, test, and manipulate database permissions and schema objects to verify proper access rights within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for creating, altering, and dropping database tables, columns, and foreign keys, as well as executing complex permission-related scenarios.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator with a Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of SchemaHelper for schema operations.

methods.name: evalCreatePermission
methods.description: Creates a temporary table with various columns to test create permissions.

methods.name: evalCrudPermission
methods.description: Performs insert, select, update, delete, and complex query operations to validate CRUD permissions.

methods.name: evalAlterPermission
methods.description: Alters the schema by adding, changing, renaming, and dropping columns to test schema modification permissions.

methods.name: evalForeignKeyPermission
methods.description: Creates tables and adds foreign keys, inserts data, tests joins and foreign key constraints handling, then cleans up.

methods.name: evalDropPermission
methods.description: Drops the temporary foreign key and tables to test drop permissions.

methods.name: evalPrivilegeDatabaseUserPermission
methods.description: Runs a sequence of permission validation steps, including dropping tables, creating schemas, and calling all schema evaluation methods.
